items.title: LIVE 🔴 India's Air Taxi, HCLTech AI Centre & Taiwan's Tamil Nadu Bet | Front Page
items.summary:
India’s air mobility race takes off as ePlane unveils the country’s first electric air taxi prototype, while HCLTech expands its AI presence in Gujarat and Taiwan targets Tamil Nadu for its next manufacturing wave.

This is your Front Page LIVE with [Host], bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business and infrastructure stories shaping India.

Today on Front Page LIVE:
- HCLTech opens a new Global Tech Center and AI Lab in GIFT City, Gujarat
- ePlane unveils India’s first electric air taxi prototype, the 2,000 kg e200X
- BHEL builds India’s first indigenous 1200 kV Ultra High Voltage transformer
- Taiwan eyes southern Tamil Nadu for semiconductors, EVs and green energy manufacturing
- Wipro reports a flat Q1 net profit of ₹3,352 crore amid margin pressure and cautious guidance
